summary: Frontend-only testing of the Caro registration wizards and restyled auth pages. Both driver (/register, 6 steps) and operator (/list-your-fleet, 9 steps) one-question-per-screen wizards work end-to-end. Progress bar, step label, back button, empty/short-password validation, Select dropdowns (int-fleet, int-heard), and final submit all behave correctly. Driver submission created an account and navigated to /portal; operator submission showed the interest-success screen. Both login pages (/login, /operator-login) render on the light off-white theme (bg rgb(249,248,246)) and expose all required testids. Driver take-home estimator and operator monthly estimator update reactively. Admin dashboard renders at /admin without crashing; admin login lands on /portal by default (admin can still navigate to /admin).

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid 'admin-filter-clear' referenced in the review request is not rendered on the page (count = 0). All other admin-filter-* testids present.
React 'Encountered two children with the same key' warnings (dozens of them) — email is used as a React key but the users/leads/interest data contains duplicate emails. Should use unique IDs as keys.
Signing in with admin@caro.co.uk navigates to /portal instead of /admin. User must manually navigate to /admin.

action_items: Optional: add data-testid='admin-filter-clear' to the clear-filters button on Admin.jsx (referenced in request but currently missing).
Fix duplicate-key React warnings on Admin.jsx by using a unique row id (e.g. _id or index) instead of email as the key.
Optional: after admin login, redirect user.role==='admin' to /admin instead of /portal for better UX.
critical_code_review_comments: Register.jsx and OperatorInterest.jsx are clean, well-structured wizards with proper validation gating (canNext) and no _id leakage.

OperatorInterest submit() calls register() and then posts to /interest — good separation, but if the /interest lead capture succeeds and register() fails, user sees a toast but the lead is still recorded. Acceptable trade-off.
Admin.jsx uses email as a React list key which triggers many duplicate-key errors — should be switched to a stable unique id.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for wizards and auth pages in scope

seed_data_creation: Created two test accounts via the wizards (TEST_drv<ts>@example.com driver and TEST_op<ts>@example.com operator)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wizards on /register (6 steps) and /list-your-fleet (9 steps) fully verified. Auth pages confirmed light-themed (main bg #F9F8F6). Only outstanding items are Admin.jsx polish (missing admin-filter-clear testid + duplicate React keys on list rendering). Registration flows successfully create accounts and navigate to /portal or the interest-success screen.
